facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_asr_dataset: create an AsrDataset instance with audio paths, durations, target transcriptions, and a target dictionary
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.review_asr_dataset_getitem: review the AsrDataset __getitem__ method that loads WAV files and extracts Kaldi fbank features with CMVN normalization

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.test_asr_dataset_ordered_indices: test the AsrDataset ordered_indices method that returns an ordered list of indices for batch construction

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.collate_samples_into_batch: collate speech recognition samples into a padded batch with source frames and target tokens

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.apply_mv_norm: apply mean-variance normalization to a batch of spectrogram feature tensors
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.lengths_to_encoder_padding_mask: convert a 1-D sequence lengths tensor into a 2-D binary encoder padding mask
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.encoder_padding_mask_to_lengths: convert a 2-D encoder padding mask back into a 1-D sequence lengths tensor
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.review_data_utils: review the speech recognition data utility functions for tensor normalization and padding mask conversion

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.pack_replabels: pack a token sequence so that repeated symbols are replaced by replabels for ASG criterion
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.unpack_replabels: unpack a token sequence so that replabels are replaced by their original repeated symbols
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.replabel_symbol: generate a replabel symbol string from an integer index for use in flashlight ASG
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.review_pack_replabels: review the pack_replabels function to understand how repeated tokens are compressed into replabels
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.test_unpack_replabels: test the unpack_replabels function to verify it correctly expands replabels back to repeated tokens
